issue.body:
I would prefere to enable "File Versioning" by default.

To keep backups is IMHO always a good idea. It helps if there is a bug in syncthing or if the user does something boring wrong... see also #353

body:
Maybe .stversions should always stored in the repro root?

e.g.:

repoRoot/dir1/file1

file1 will be deleted or modified, store it here:

repoRoot/.stversions/dir1/file1~YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS

dir1 will be deleted, move it to:

repoRoot/.stversions/dir1~YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS/file1

that was also my first idea.

maybe seperate deleted files, for example in .trash and versions.

Am 16.06.2014 um 11:59 schrieb Jens Diemer notifications@github.com:

> Maybe .stversions should always stored in the repro root?
> 
> e.g.:

>

> repoRoot/.stversions/dir1/file1~YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS

> repoRoot/.stversions/dir1~YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS/file1

> Reply to this email directly or view it on GitHub.

An easier workaround may be to check if the directory contains _nothing else_ except .stversions and in that case don't propagate this particular change. IDK if it's possible with the current design though but it may be easier than reimplementing the .stversions logic. Or vice versa, of course.
The latter would get tricky because we _should_ announce and sync empty directories. I'm moving the .stversions dir in v0.9.

issue.title: syncthing cannot delete directory that contains only an .stignored file

labels.name: bug
labels.description: A problem with current functionality, as opposed to missing functionality (enhancement)

issue.body:
On the Mac laptop I have:

```
$ cat .stignore
.DS_Store
```

Then I have a directory and some files:

```
blah/.DS_Store
blah/one
blah/two
blah/three
```

On the other side I have a Linux box, and I delete

```
rm blah/one
rm blah/two
rm blah/three
```

Then I delete

```
rmdir blah
```

Back on the Mac side, there is an error in the gui that blah/ cannot be deleted since it is not empty (it contains .DS_Store).

On the Linux side the blah directory gets recreated.

I understand why this all happens, but is this intended behaviour? :)

body:
> I'm moving the .stversions dir in v0.9.

But there are still.stversions folders inside other folders for people who used to run <v0.9, which still leads to errors like `[POWFP] 10:14:10 INFO: Puller ... delete: remove ... directory not empty`  Should these have been moved to the new location during the upgrade?
@endolith: Did you figure this out? Wondering the same thing.
